purpose: Bind each A0-R latent observation to an exact production subject, deterministic service configuration, fresh-state boundary, source-proved CfC transition semantics, and seal-before-label execution order.
Fail closed when a latent cannot be shown to come from the declared recurrent substrate under the frozen measurement configuration.
Prevent vector presence, all-zero fallbacks, hidden state reuse, masking drift, random initialization, or post-label retuning from being misreported as representational evidence.
claim_boundary: V1 may establish decodability only for the frozen deterministic CfC model instance and frozen measurement configuration.
V1 does not establish architecture-wide decodability across independently initialized Symthaea instances; that requires a separately preregistered cross-genesis replication.
A valid recurrent vector does not establish that production policy causally uses the decoded relation.
A probe success does not establish a native behavioral response, metacognitive recruitment, ontology repair, consciousness, sentience, or phenomenology.

service_state_contract.within_fixture_temporal_state: preserve only the declared evidence sequence for that fixture
service_state_contract.service_instance_id_rule: domain-separated deterministic receipt identifier; unique per run/base-fixture/transform/technical-replicate and never exposed as a probe feature
service_state_contract.constructor_count_gate: qualification must prove one CognitiveLoopService construction for every executed technical replicate and zero reuse across receipt instance IDs
service_state_contract.receipt_id_rule: receipt_id is a deterministic domain-separated identifier for run/base-fixture/transform/cycle/technical-replicate; it is receipt metadata only and forbidden as a probe feature

runner_config_v1.constructor: CognitiveLoopConfig::with_cfc() followed by the explicit overrides below
runner_config_v1.full_config_binding: runner_config_effective must contain the full canonical JSON projection used by the runner; canonical_config_sha256 is SHA-256 of RFC8259 JSON serialized with sorted keys and separators ',' ':' over that object
runner_config_v1.feature_binding: enabled_features is a sorted unique array; enabled_feature_set_sha256 is SHA-256 of the UTF-8 newline-joined array values; target triple is receipt-bound separately
runner_config_v1.binary_binding: exact executable SHA-256 must be receipt-bound

source_theorem.conclusion: Under the exact frozen source and runner_config_v1 with TemporalBackend::CfC and a nonempty genesis-seeded CfC network, temporal_network.step() and temporal_network.read_state() cannot reach their Result error branches. The planning stale-state and zero-state fallback warnings are therefore unreachable for an eligible V1 receipt.
preconditions: all source bindings below match exact Git blob SHA-1 values
temporal_backend is explicitly CfC; relying on TemporalBackend::default() is forbidden because the frozen default is HdcLtcUnified
genesis_phrase is Some(frozen phrase), selecting the deterministic CfCNetwork::from_genesis constructor path
CfCNetworkConfig retains the frozen default num_layers=2, so the recurrent cell vector is nonempty
no production source bytes in the bound source files differ from the production subject

source_bindings.fact: frozen default backend is HdcLtcUnified and frozen CfC dimensions/dt are declared here
explicit CfC config constructs a genesis-seeded CfC network and wraps it in TemporalNetwork::CfC
TemporalNetwork delegates V1 step/read directly to CfCNetwork
genesis-seeded CfC has two layers; step returns Ok after forward and read_state returns the last cell state

required_substrings: CfC temporal step failed — continuing with stale state
CfC read_state failed in output read — using zero state
source_bindings.fact: generic warning/fallback paths and both recurrent masking controls exist; V1 makes them unreachable/disabled via the theorem and config gate
with_cfc explicitly selects CfC; frozen defaults disable recurrent and spectral masking

source_theorem.nonfinite_caveat: Result-path infallibility does not prove numerical finiteness. Every collected vector must independently pass the finite-value gate.

technical_repeatability_gate.comparison: bit-identical channel bytes across the two fresh-service replicates for cfc_recurrent_state, perception_hdv_binary, and perception_chunk32 at the preregistered measurement cycle
technical_repeatability_gate.pairwise_exclusion: if either technical replicate is invalid or the pair mismatches, the entire measurement group is excluded from probe fitting and the scientific denominator

measurement_cycle.primary: single preregistered final relational-state cycle from PARADOX-A0R-STATISTICS-V1
measurement_cycle.negative_control: pre-relation or first-evidence cycle where the latent contract permits it

vector_encoding.perception_chunk32: exact f32 IEEE-754 little-endian bytes in feature order
vector_encoding.perception_hdv_binary: canonical packed binary HDC bytes as exported by the frozen runner
vector_encoding.raw_vector_retention: allowed only in development evidence storage; receipt itself may contain digest plus summary fields

feature set, target triple, and executable are bound
source theorem preconditions and all source blob bindings pass
cfc vector nonfinite count is zero

forbidden_inferences: nonzero vector therefore semantic information exists
high probe accuracy therefore production policy uses the atom
validity_rules.invalid_measurement_reporting: report count and reason by target/channel; never silently discard

score and aggregate by independent base semantic fixture

receipt_set_rules.pairwise_invalidity_rule: if either member is not ELIGIBLE_A0R_MEASUREMENT, neither member may enter probe fitting or the scientific denominator
receipt_set_rules.no_partial_pair_rule: a missing technical replicate is INVALID_MEASUREMENT_NONDETERMINISTIC, not a one-replicate measurement
